scope: Ten exact item references gain documented boss/reward source hints. Existing exchange quantities, limits, box identities, nonmarket exclusions and calculations stay unchanged.

conditions: Guild ranking is generated by a five-player party in the same guild; ranking reward is weekly and goes to the guild. Rank levels4/5 correspond to positions4-10/11-25, not literal positions4/5.
Guild-boss expedition regions exclude Apprentice members and War Heroes.
Hollow Maretta source is chance-qualified and located in Margoria; no invented spawn guarantee or rate.
Resplendent Lightstone exchange identity already exists (59858-59861), even though the all-item projection's catalog id is null. No global market-ID fallback or marketability change was needed.
limits: No exhaustive timed-event, coupon or quest list; no numerical boss/drop/opening probabilities certified.
2024patch labels guild-ranking loot as chance while current guide puts the Lightstones in guaranteed reward table. No yield/guarantee claim is encoded; only eligibility/source is added.
Other guild boss rewards are not blanket inferred. Advice variants +200 and above do not gain these hints.
No automatic boss-farming profitability or random-container pricing introduced.
